fragment:
<when condition="@(!context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("authHeader").StartsWith("Bearer "))">
			
				
				
					application/json
				
				{"title": "Unauthorized", "status": 401, "detail": "Missing or invalid Authorization header"}
			
		
	
	
	<set-variable name="bearerToken" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("authHeader").Substring("Bearer ".Length).Trim())" />
	
	
	
	<set-variable name="sessionTokenCacheKey" value="@{
    var token = (string)context.Variables["bearerToken"];
    if (!(bool)context.Variables["isV2SessionToken"])
    {
      return token.Length < 64 ? "" : "{{session-token-cache-prefix}}" + token;
    }

    var parts = token.Split('.');
    if (token.Length < 129 || parts.Length != 2 || parts[0].Length == 0 || parts[1].Length == 0)
    {
      return "";
    }

    using (var sha256 = System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256.Create())
    {
      var bytes = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(parts[1]);
      var hash = BitConverter.ToString(sha256.ComputeHash(bytes)).Replace("-", "").ToLowerInvariant();
      return "{{session-token-cache-prefix}}" + parts[0] + "." + hash;
    }
  }" />
	
	
		
			
				
				
					application/json
				
				{"title": "Unauthorized", "status": 401, "detail": "Missing or invalid Bearer token"}
			
		
	
	
	<cache-lookup-value key="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("sessionTokenCacheKey"))" variable-name="cachedUserData" caching-type="internal" />
	
	
		
			
			
			
				@((string)context.Variables["cachedUserData"])
			
		
		
			
			
			
			
				@((string)context.Variables["sessionIntrospectionUrl"])
				GET
				
					application/json
				
				
					@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("authHeader"))
				
				
					{{platform-api-gateway-hostname-internal}}
				
			
			
				
					
					<set-variable name="introspectionBody" value="@(((IResponse)context.Variables["introspectionResponse"]).Body.As())" />
					<set-variable name="tokenTtl" value="@(Math.Min(((JObject)context.Variables["introspectionBody"]).Value("token_remaining_ttl"), 300))" />
					
					
					
						
							<cache-store-value key="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("sessionTokenCacheKey"))" value="@((string)context.Variables["userData"])" duration="@((int)context.Variables["tokenTtl"])" caching-type="internal" />
						
					
					
					
					
					
						@((string)context.Variables["userData"])
					
				
				
					
						
					
				
				
					
						
						
							application/json
						
						{"title": "Proxy Error", "status": 500, "detail": "The token introspection-endpoint returns an error"}
